Package com.kerosene.kfe.paymentrequest.adapters.in.scheduling

Class KfePaymentRequestLightningMonitor

java.lang.Object
com.kerosene.kfe.paymentrequest.adapters.in.scheduling.KfePaymentRequestLightningMonitor
@Service public class KfePaymentRequestLightningMonitor extends Object
Polls OPEN Lightning payment requests and credits destination wallets when invoices settle.

Stream subscription (ITEM 21): subscribes to real-time LND invoice updates via LightningInvoiceGateway.subscribeInvoices(java.util.function.Consumer<com.kerosene.kfe.adapters.out.rail.custody.CustodyGateway.IncomingLightningInvoiceStatus>). Events are processed immediately; the polling loop acts as a reconciliation safety net for stream-missed events.

Payment state tracking (ITEM 22): differentiates IN_FLIGHT (HTLC routed, not settled), SUCCEEDED (confirmed by LND), FAILED (payment failed), and UNKNOWN (ambiguous/timeout). Only SUCCEEDED credits the ledger.

  • Constructor Details

    • KfePaymentRequestLightningMonitor

      public KfePaymentRequestLightningMonitor(KfePaymentRequestRepository paymentRequestRepository, KfeTransactionRepository transactionRepository, @Qualifier("kfeExternalLightningInvoiceGateway") LightningInvoiceGateway lightningInvoiceGateway, KfePricingService pricingService, KfeBalanceService balanceService, KfeBalanceMovementRecorder movementRecorder, KfeFeeSettlementService feeSettlementService, KfeAuditLogService auditLogService, KfeStatementService statementService, KfeResponseMapper responseMapper, KfeDashboardPublisher dashboardPublisher, @Value("${kfe.payment-request-lightning-monitor.enabled:true}") boolean enabled, @Value("${kfe.payment-request-lightning-monitor.batch-size:25}") int batchSize, @Lazy KfePaymentRequestLightningMonitor self, @Autowired(required=false) KfeWebhookDeliveryService webhookDeliveryService, @Autowired(required=false) com.kerosene.common.financial.notification.FinancialNotificationPort notificationPort)
      Creates the stream-and-polling reconciler; polling batches are clamped to at least one row. Optional webhook and direct notification ports may be absent in reduced deployments.
      Parameters:
      paymentRequestRepository - payment-request lookup and locking repository
      transactionRepository - inbound transaction/idempotency repository
      lightningInvoiceGateway - provider invoice stream and query gateway
      pricingService - inbound Lightning fee and receiver-amount calculator
      balanceService - destination wallet credit service
      movementRecorder - ledger movement writer
      feeSettlementService - platform fee ledger service
      auditLogService - audit event writer
      statementService - user statement writer
      responseMapper - transaction display payload builder
      dashboardPublisher - post-commit dashboard refresh publisher
      enabled - whether asynchronous reconciliation is enabled
      batchSize - requested page size, clamped to one or greater
      self - proxied monitor for transactional callback entry
      webhookDeliveryService - optional after-commit webhook publisher
      notificationPort - optional best-effort notification fallback

    • reconcileOpenLightningPaymentRequests

      @Scheduled(fixedDelayString="${kfe.payment-request-lightning-monitor.fixed-delay-ms:1000}", initialDelayString="${kfe.payment-request-lightning-monitor.initial-delay-ms:2000}") public void reconcileOpenLightningPaymentRequests()
      Periodically probes every page of OPEN Lightning requests as a recovery path for missed stream events. Provider lookups happen outside settlement transactions; each passing settlement is delegated through the Spring self proxy so its row lock and ledger effects run transactionally.

    • markFailed

      @Transactional public void markFailed(UUID paymentRequestId, String rawStatus, String rawPayload)
      Marks an open request failed under a row lock and records sanitized status evidence. Repeated callbacks and requests already transitioned from OPEN are no-ops.
      Parameters:
      paymentRequestId - request to transition
      rawStatus - provider status used to explain the terminal failure
      rawPayload - provider payload retained for signature compatibility; not persisted here

    • expireRequest

      @Transactional public void expireRequest(UUID paymentRequestId)
      Expires an open request only if its deadline has passed when the row lock is acquired.
      Parameters:
      paymentRequestId - request to expire

    • settleSettledInvoice

      @Transactional public void settleSettledInvoice(UUID paymentRequestId, long receivedSats, String rawPayload)
      Settles an invoice for an OPEN request under lock, then schedules notifications and webhook delivery after the transaction commits. Duplicate callbacks are absorbed by request state and the transaction idempotency key.
      Parameters:
      paymentRequestId - request whose invoice settled
      receivedSats - amount reported received by LND
      rawPayload - provider observation payload used only to derive statement evidence

    • reconcileExpiredButSettled

      @Transactional public void reconcileExpiredButSettled(UUID paymentRequestId, long receivedSats, String rawPayload)
      Credits a payment request that was found settled on LND despite KFE marking it expired. This reconciliation path prevents orphaned payments when LND settles near the deadline and the monitor hasn't observed it before the KFE expiry clock ticked.
